_meta.unit: one session as written = one day x one week-column x one level-column. BYOP templates: every slot counts even when the EXERCISE cell still reads 'CHOOSE' (the CATEGORY/PURPOSE label is the coach's design). Circuits ('CIRCUITS RECCOMENDED' block of FAT BURN) are listed separately and excluded from R1-R10 denominators.
_meta.classification: movement tags from the coach's slot label when one exists (BYOP CATEGORY/PURPOSE; BASEBALL Part labels such as 'bkd','horiz pull','Upper Ballistics/plyo'; HYBRID B/D labels) else from exercise-name keywords (INFERRED). ROLE (= coach slot pattern) is used for pairing/alternation rules R8/R9/N3/N7/N16; movement tags for everything else.
_meta.baseball_labels: BASEBALL Week 1 of Block 1 and Weeks 1/3 of Block 3 have no label column (it holds the previous day's exercise list); their slot labels are the modal label of the same row across sibling weeks with the same header row (INFERRED, flagged per item as slot_borrowed).
